description: Rokid Glasses AIUI Agent - sign filter: in an unfamiliar street, declare a target shop or door plate first, then walk and photograph signs; only a sign whose LLM-read text contains the target lights up with a banner and one TTS call naming the facing direction, while non-matching signs only increment a silent seen count. No sign database, no positioning: the match is a plain contains comparison on read text, a misread character can miss or false-hit, and direction is the wearer-declared facing direction at photo time. All walk data lives in session memory only and is wiped when the summary is confirmed or the agent closes.
name: sign-filter
